tools.name: list_formulas
tools.description: List every formula key in the library (call this if unsure of a key).

tools.name: solve_formula
tools.description: Solve a named library formula for its one unknown variable.
tools.args_signature: {"key": "ideal_gas", "values": {"P": 1, "n": 2, "T": 300}}  (leave exactly one variable out of values)

tools.name: solve_custom
tools.description: Solve ANY formula you write, for any named variable — not limited to the library.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Evaluate a plain arithmetic/scientific expression exactly (+ - * / ** sqrt log sin cos ...).

tools.name: generate_numerical
tools.description: Generate and render a full randomized notebook-style numerical for a topic (kinetics/mole/etc).

tools.name: plot_preset
tools.description: Plot one of the 10 built-in animated chemistry curves (kinetics, Arrhenius, Boyle's, titration...).

tools.name: plot_function
tools.description: Plot/animate ANY 2D function you name yourself, e.g. a curve not in the presets.

tools.name: plot_surface
tools.description: Export a high-quality 3D surface PNG: built-in ('orbital_3d','pvt') or any z=f(x,y) you name.

tools.name: simulate_atom_2d
tools.description: Run the live 2D animated Bohr atom / electron / proton / neutron simulation for an element.

tools.name: simulate_atom_3d
tools.description: Run the live real-time 3D atom / electron / proton simulation (rotatable) for an element.

tools.name: simulate_orbital
tools.description: Run the live quantum orbital electron-cloud Monte-Carlo simulation (1s,2s,2p,3s,3p,3d).

tools.name: orbital_grid
tools.description: Export a reference-chart PNG of many hydrogen orbitals' |psi|^2 side by side (n up to 4).

tools.name: bonding_map
tools.description: Export a stylized chemical-bonding electron-density map (ELF-style, rainbow colormap) for a molecule.
tools.args_signature: {"molecule": "furan"}  (available: furan, water, methane, co2, ethanol, benzene)

tools.name: bloch_sphere
tools.description: Export a Bloch sphere for a single qubit state, with exact Z/X/Y measurement probabilities.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the live web for current information (no API key needed).

tools.name: deep_research
tools.description: Run several web searches on different angles of a topic and synthesize a cited summary.

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.description: Read/analyze a file or image the user imported with /import this session.
tools.args_signature: {"path": "notes.txt"}  (path can be a partial match; omit to use the most recent import)

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a real file from disk by path (workspace-relative or absolute).

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List a real folder's contents by path (workspace-relative or absolute).
tools.args_signature: {"path": "src"}  (omit path to list the workspace root)

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a real file on disk with the given text content.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a real folder on disk (and any missing parent folders).

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Permanently delete a single real file on disk (folders are refused).

tools.name: rename_file
tools.description: Rename/move a real file or folder on disk.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Edit a file by replacing old_text with new_text (find/replace). The old_text must appear exactly in the file.

tools.name: search_workspace
tools.description: Search for files or content in the workspace. Returns matching lines with file:line.

tools.name: archive_list
tools.description: List all entries in an archive (ZIP, tar.gz, tar.bz2) — folders and files, with sizes. Use this FIRST on any attached/compressed file.

tools.name: archive_delete_entries
tools.description: Delete entries from a ZIP archive by exact name or glob pattern; folder names remove the whole folder tree. Safe-replace: original preserved until the modified copy validates.

tools.name: archive_extract
tools.description: Extract an archive into a real destination folder (default: a folder named after the archive in the workspace).

tools.name: archive_add_entries
tools.description: Add files (from disk) and/or new text entries into an existing ZIP archive.

tools.name: archive_repack
tools.description: Rebuild a ZIP fresh: recompress, dedupe repeated names, optionally drop directory placeholder entries (drop_dirs).

tools.name: archive_validate
tools.description: Validate that an archive file is intact and readable (zip CRC test / tar read-through). Run this after any modification.

tools.name: run_build
tools.description: Build the project in the active workspace (auto-detects npm/pyproject/setup.py/cargo/Makefile/CMake, or pass an explicit command). Real build output and exit code.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Run the project's test suite (auto-detects pytest/npm test/cargo/go test, or pass an explicit command). Real results.

tools.name: inspect_project
tools.description: Inspect the active workspace/project: layout, folders, files, manifests (package.json / pyproject.toml / ...). Use this to ground yourself before acting.

tools.name: run_terminal
tools.description: Run a terminal command on the user's machine in the active workspace folder (e.g. 'python main.py', 'pip install ...'). The user sees the command, its output, and the exit code.

tools.name: install_packages
tools.description: Install real packages with the Autonomous Package Manager (pip/npm/cargo/brew/winget...). Governed by the active permission mode: asks in Ask-Each-Time, automatic in Full Access, refused in Restricted. Unknown packages are researched first.

tools.name: device_action
tools.description: Request an action on the user's authorized device via the Responsible Device Control framework (terminal, simulation; desktop/android/ios/browser are extension points).
